clips.title: The story
paras: Fahrad keeps Ravenholdt supplied with locked boxes for rogue training. His demand never ends, and he trades specialized throwing knives to anyone who brings authentic heavy junkboxes.

Ravenholdt Manor is a hidden redoubt in the mountains above Hillsbrad Foothills. Training never ceases there. Master thief Fahrad oversees the guild's operatives and prizes practical skill at picking locks. Zan supplies practice contraptions for new recruits, but Fahrad finds them too crude for experienced thieves who must open stubborn mechanisms in the field.

Fahrad contracts for heavy junkboxes stolen from dangerous targets across Azeroth, and he accepts deliveries in batches. Only skilled thieves can lift the boxes from their marks in the wild, but anyone may bring them to the manor. Even boxes picked clean of major valuables earn Fahrad's favor and a supply of the manor's finely balanced throwing knives, so long as a token coin remains inside to motivate the initiates.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My rogues need to hone their lockpicking skills, and I need locks of adequate difficulty—the stuff Zan makes us is unfit for all but the lowliest neophytes.
Tell ya what, if you bring me 5 Heavy Junkboxes, I'll provide you with some of the finest throwing knives known to roguekind.
You can unlock the boxes and rifle through them, but you'll have to leave at least a few coins in them... Even a rogue in training needs motivation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: May these knives find a place in someone's heart.
